official.deadline_note: 2027/28 deadlines are TBC - UCD states applications for the 2027/28 Global Excellence Scholarships will open in November 2026, with details available by early November. The closed 2026/27 round used regional deadlines of 1 February 2026 (undergraduate applicants from North America), 28 February 2026 (undergraduate and graduate taught applicants from the Middle East, Africa and Pakistan, and graduate taught applicants from South Asia) and 31 March 2026 (all other applicants); the application portal closed at 11:59pm Irish Time and late applications were not considered.
official.application_cycle: 2027/28 cycle for September 2028 entry; applications open November 2026, dates TBC (the 2026/27 round closed in March 2026)
official.status_note: The official page states applications for the 2027/28 Global Excellence Scholarships will open in November 2026, dates TBC, with details being finalised and available by early November. The 2026/27 competition is closed.
official.tuition_coverage_note: UCD publishes: "Funding provided: 100% and 50% tuition fee scholarships" and the Terms & Conditions state "The Global Excellence Scholarship is payable only toward the tuition fees charged to the successful candidate" and "Scholarships will not cover tuition fees incurred as a result of students taking additional modules, above the standard credit load for their programme."
benefits: A limited number of 100% tuition fee scholarships for outstanding international students
A limited number of 50% tuition fee scholarships for outstanding international students
Successful awardees of the 100% Global Excellence Scholarship will have their deposit refunded following registration at UCD
For multi-year programmes, scholarships are renewed each year on condition that the student maintains a Stage GPA of 3.08/4.20 and meets the programme progression and credit requirements
eligibility: Open only to incoming students entering a new programme at UCD who are classed as non-EU for tuition fee purposes
Scholarships are only open to self-funding candidates who are classified as non-EU for tuition fee purposes
Eligible programmes are limited to undergraduate and graduate taught programmes where the student must be based in Dublin and no part of the programme is awarded by another institution

Excluded programmes: online programmes, January start programmes, part-time programmes, clinical programmes, off-shore campus programmes, and the UCD International Study Centre International Foundation Year Pathway
Applicants must already hold an Offer, Conditional Offer, Accept or Conditional Accept status on an application for an eligible programme

Applicants must meet the citizenship and residence requirements set out in the Regional Information of the Terms & Conditions (citizens of the region for North America, South Asia, and Middle East/Africa/Pakistan; citizens and/or residents of any countries outside the EU/EEA/Swiss Confederation for All Other Regions)
The Global Excellence Scholarship cannot be combined with any other tuition fee scholarship
requirements: Without exception, only complete applications received on or before the regional deadline will be considered; the application portal closes at 11.59pm Irish Time and late applications will not be considered
Applications must be submitted in accordance with the Global Excellence Scholarship Application Instructions

Scholarship applications are considered on academic merit paired with a holistic review of the applicant's response to the scholarship application questions (motivations for studying at UCD, alignment with UCD's values, experience and achievements, contributions to equality, diversity and inclusion, and potential to act as an Ambassador for UCD)

Candidates must pay the deposit required upon acceptance of an offer to study at UCD; only candidates who have paid their deposit when accepting the scholarship will secure both the scholarship and a place on the programme
Students must accept their scholarship offer online within the timeframe communicated by the International Scholarships and Funding Team
Only students who remain continuously enrolled at UCD full-time may retain their scholarship
documents: Completed application to an eligible UCD programme, holding Offer, Conditional Offer, Accept or Conditional Accept status
Global Excellence Scholarship application submitted via SISWeb answering the General Questions
Payment of the required deposit when accepting the offer to study at UCD
Online acceptance of the scholarship offer within the communicated timeframe
selection_criteria: Holistic review of the applicant's response to the scholarship application questions, exploring motivations for studying at UCD, alignment with UCD's values, experience and achievements, contributions to equality, diversity and inclusion, and potential to act as an Ambassador for UCD
Recipients are selected by a committee comprising staff from each of UCD's six Colleges, supported by UCD Global
An annual competition selects a limited number of students per region; the Scholarship Committee's decisions are final and cannot be appealed
coverage: 100% tuition fee scholarships and 50% tuition fee scholarships only - payable solely toward the tuition fees charged to the successful candidate
No living cost, accommodation, travel or other support is published
application_method: Log in to SISWeb with UCD Connect details (the same 8-digit ID and password used for the programme application)
Select 'Applications' at the top of the page

Click 'Scholarship Applications' and select the Global Excellence Scholarship (the link only displays if the call is open, regional eligibility is met and an Offer, Conditional Offer, Accept or Conditional Accept status is held)
Answer the General Questions and submit before 11.59pm Irish Time on the regional deadline
official.application_route: Apply for an eligible UCD programme, secure an offer, then during the open call log in to SISWeb (Applications > Scholarship Applications) and submit the General Questions before 11.59pm Irish Time on your regional deadline.
official.study_mode: Full-time - the student must be based in Dublin; part-time programmes are excluded
official.citizenship_residency: Applicants must meet the citizenship and residence requirements in the Regional Information: citizens of the region for North America (undergraduate only), South Asia (graduate taught only) and Middle East, Africa and Pakistan; citizens and/or residents of any countries outside the EU/EEA/Swiss Confederation for All Other Regions. All applicants must be classified as non-EU for tuition fees and UCD admissions.
official.international_eligibility: Open only to international students classed as non-EU for tuition fee purposes
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Programme-based, not subject-based: undergraduate and graduate taught programmes only, with online, January-start, part-time, clinical, off-shore campus and UCD ISC International Foundation Year Pathway programmes excluded; the programme must appear on the Published Eligible Programmes list and the student must be based in Dublin
official.duration: Applicable only to the programme and academic term specified in the offer letter containing the scholarship award; for multi-year programmes the award is renewed each year of the programme subject to maintaining a Stage GPA of 3.08/4.20 and meeting progression and credit requirements. The scholarship is non-transferable and cannot be deferred - deferring entry forfeits it
official.description: Each year UCD offers a number of Global Excellence Scholarships for international students (on non-EU fees) starting their courses in September, providing a limited number of 100% and 50% tuition fee scholarships to outstanding candidates applying to undergraduate and graduate taught programmes. The scholarships aim to attract outstanding candidates to UCD programmes and to encourage early applications.
official.program_type: University-funded tuition fee scholarship (100% or 50% of tuition fees) for incoming non-EU international students on undergraduate and graduate taught programmes

applicant_utility.summary: This award waives either 50% or 100% of your non-EU tuition fee for one eligible UCD programme, and you can only apply after you already hold an offer on a course that appears on UCD's eligible-programmes list. The scholarship application itself is short - a set of general questions in SISWeb - but the schedule is unforgiving: the portal shuts at 11:59pm Irish time on your region's deadline and late files are not read. You will need to fund everything else yourself - living costs, flights, insurance and, for 50% winners, half the tuition - so treat this as tuition relief, not full funding.
applicant_utility.best_fit: High-achieving non-EU applicants to UCD undergraduate or taught master's programmes who can apply early enough to hold an offer before their regional deadline and can cover living costs independently
application_readiness_checklist: Apply for the UCD programme months ahead - UCD warns of processing delays during peak scholarship windows and you need an Offer, Conditional Offer, Accept or Conditional Accept status before the scholarship link appears
Confirm your exact programme is on the Published Eligible Programmes list - clinical, online, January-start, part-time, off-shore and UCD ISC foundation pathway programmes are excluded

Check which regional deadline matches your citizenship/residence (North America undergraduate, South Asia graduate taught, Middle East/Africa/Pakistan, or All Other Regions) rather than assuming a single global date

Draft the five question themes in advance: motivation for studying at UCD, alignment with UCD's values, experience and achievements, contributions to equality/diversity/inclusion, and your potential as a UCD Ambassador
Have your UCD Connect (SISWeb) 8-digit login ready and submit well before 11:59pm Irish time on the deadline day
Be ready to pay the programme deposit the moment you accept an offer - it secures both your place and the scholarship (refunded after registration only for 100% recipients)
Watch for the scholarship offer notification and accept it online within the stated timeframe - silence counts as declining and a lapsed offer cannot be reinstated
common_rejection_risks: Choosing a programme that is on UCD's excluded list or missing from the eligible-programmes document

Missing the regional deadline because you waited for a single global date or for the admissions offer to be processed - UCD explicitly cannot guarantee applications are processed before the scholarship deadline
Applying without holding an Offer, Conditional Offer, Accept or Conditional Accept status - the scholarship link will not even display
Submitting after 11:59pm Irish time on the deadline date, or submitting an incomplete application, which is disqualified without exception
Holding offers for several programmes without nominating the single programme you want considered
Accepting the scholarship offer late, or accepting it without having paid the required deposit
Any material misrepresentation in the application, which causes immediate disqualification even if discovered later
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Living expenses and accommodation in Dublin, flights, health insurance, and the remaining 50% of tuition fees for 50% recipients; tuition for any extra credits above the standard programme load is not covered, and the deposit is only refunded to 100% recipients after registration
document_audit: There is no separate scholarship document pack - the scholarship application is question-based in SISWeb, and your academic record is assessed through the programme application, so errors in transcripts or references surface as a weak or delayed admission offer
Your non-EU fee classification must be confirmed with UCD before you rely on eligibility - check the fees page if you have any EU/EEA connection
The eligible-programmes list and Terms & Conditions are the binding documents - the summary page wording is not
If an admission offer is still pending near the deadline, chase the programme office early; the scholarship window will not wait
alerts: For 2027/28 entry the call opens in November 2026 with dates TBC - check the official page from early November rather than trusting last year's February/March pattern
The scholarship cannot be combined with any other tuition fee scholarship, so compare it against other offers before applying
Deferring your UCD entry forfeits the award - you would have to re-apply for your deferred year with no guarantee
Continuation is conditional: you must maintain a Stage GPA of 3.08/4.20 and meet progression and credit requirements, and you must stay continuously enrolled full-time
Recipients commit to ambassador-style activity (social media or website content, peer engagement, panels/surveys) as directed by UCD
Decisions are final and cannot be appealed, and results arrive roughly seven weeks after the regional deadline, so plan your funding assumption well past spring
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Submit the programme application first and hold an offer, then during the open call log in to SISWeb, go to Applications > Scholarship Applications, answer the General Questions and submit before the 11:59pm Irish-time cut-off for your region; outcomes land in SISWeb about seven weeks later
